title: 第四千二百一十七章 妖花的实力第四千二百一十六章 鏖战尊者四
content_zh:
八雷尊者眼中的惊讶之色更浓了，他一眼看出噬仙妖花不过仙尊境三重天的实力。
这种实力根本就不被他放在眼中，按理说抬手间便可轻易镇压。
然而此刻，噬仙妖花却接连挡住了他两次攻击，他还从未见过如此抗打的对手。
毕竟噬仙妖花和剑尘不一样，八雷尊者能感觉到剑尘完全是依仗外力，才能做到几乎不死不灭。
而眼前这株噬仙妖花，是完全依靠自身实力！
远方，刚刚才稳定住身形的千魂魔尊也明显怔了一怔，看向噬仙妖花的目光中充满了惊讶。
曾经，他和噬仙妖花在太初神殿里有过多次切磋，那时候的噬仙妖花，尽管表现出的防御力已经不弱，但还远没有达到此刻这般程度，竟然能承受八雷尊者的攻击。
“原来它当年与我切磋，竟隐藏了大部分实力，这噬仙妖花藏的可真够深啊。”千魂魔尊瞬间就想明白了，但他动作却是没有半分停顿，身上魔焰滔天，瞬间凝聚成一柄黑色长剑斩向八雷尊者。
八雷尊者尽管被噬仙妖花的八根主腾束缚在一个狭小空间内，但他动作却不受丝毫影响，手掌一握，一道雷霆闪电赫然出现在手中，抖手间就与魔气长剑碰撞在一起。
“轰！”
魔气长剑直接土崩瓦解，被一击溃散，露出了千魂魔尊的身影，此刻，他的身躯在半空中踉跄倒退，表现的很是不堪。
“这该死的神雷，恰好克制本魔尊！”千魂魔尊看了眼依旧在坚挺的噬仙妖花，似乎大受刺激，忍不住咒骂。
而八雷尊者，则是继续对噬仙妖花出手，他手握成拳，狂暴的雷霆力量在天地间肆意纵横，狠狠的砸在噬仙妖花的主腾上。
“轰！”
相互交织的八根主腾，裂缝顿时变得更密集了。
“轰！”
当八雷尊者又一次攻击落下时，噬仙妖花的八根主腾上，顿时洒落不少碎块，八根主腾已经变得破败不堪。
但紧接着，噬仙妖花主腾上所受的创伤，竟是以肉眼可见的速度在恢复。
这恢复速度尽管远不如剑尘的生命之源，但效果也是极其惊人。
噬仙妖花，同样兼具不死之身！

它的这一能力，是来自于玄黄小天界内的那只不死凤凰。
当年在玄黄小天界内，守护开天神树的那只不死凤凰，被莫天云和雨上人联合紫青双剑给艰难斩杀，最终那只不死凤凰的尸体被剑尘收走，作为噬仙妖花增强实力的一大资源。
噬仙妖花在吞噬了那只凤凰的尸体后，同时也继承了独属于那只凤凰的不死能力。
当然，这所谓的不死并不是真正意义上的不死不灭，而是指其恢复能力快的惊人，几乎等同于不死之身。
而也正是因为有了这不死能力的加持，才使得噬仙妖花在八雷尊者手中，能够支撑这么长时间。
轰！轰！轰！
空旷的神殿内，雷霆力量的轰鸣声接连不断的传出，八雷尊者疯狂出手，仙尊境五重天的浩荡之力在天地间震荡不止，绽放出极致璀璨的光彩。
他在极短的时间内足足打出十几次攻击，犹如狂风骤雨般猛烈，这才终于在一道震耳欲聋的轰鸣声中，将噬仙妖花八根主腾交织而成的囚笼给打的寸寸断裂。
顿时，囚笼破碎，八根主腾化作无数碎片四处飞溅。
content_en:
The surprise in Lord Ba Lei's eyes became even stronger. He could tell at a glance that the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower was not as strong as the third level of the Immortal Realm.
This kind of strength is not taken seriously by him at all, and it stands to reason that he can easily suppress it with a raise of his hand.
However, at this moment, the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower blocked his attacks twice in succession. He had never seen such a resistant opponent before.
After all, the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower is different from Jian Chen. Lord Ba Lei can feel that Jian Chen relies entirely on external forces to achieve almost immortality.
And the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower in front of me relies entirely on its own strength!
In the distance, the Thousand Soul Demon Lord, who had just stabilized his figure, was obviously startled, and his eyes were full of surprise when he looked at the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower.
In the past, he and the Immortal-Devouring Demonic Flower had many spars in Taichu Temple. At that time, although the Immortal-Eating Demonic Flower's defense was not weak, it was still far from the level it is at this moment. It could withstand the attack of Lord Eight Thunders.
"It turns out that when it competed with me, it actually hid most of its strength. The Immortal Devouring Demon Flower is really hidden deep enough." The Thousand Souls Demon Lord figured it out in an instant, but his movements did not pause for a moment. The demonic flames on his body were so strong that they instantly condensed into a long black sword and slashed at the Eight Thunder Lords.
Even though Lord Eight Thunders was restrained in a small space by the eight stems of the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower, his movements were not affected in the slightest. As soon as he held his palm, a bolt of thunder and lightning suddenly appeared in his hand, and in the blink of an eye it collided with the demonic sword.
"Boom!"
The demonic sword immediately collapsed and was defeated by a single blow, revealing the figure of the Thousand Souls Demon Lord. At this moment, his body staggered backwards in mid-air, showing a very unbearable performance.
"This damn divine thunder just happened to restrain me!" The Thousand Souls Demon Lord glanced at the still erect Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower. He seemed to be greatly stimulated and couldn't help cursing.
Lord Ba Lei continued to attack the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower. He clenched his hands into fists, and the violent thunder power spread freely between the heaven and the earth, hitting the main body of the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower fiercely.
"Boom!"
The cracks among the eight intertwined main beams suddenly became denser.
"Boom!"
When the Eight Thunder Lord attacked again, the eight main wings of the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower flew up, and a lot of fragments were scattered. The eight main wings had become dilapidated.
But immediately afterwards, the wounds suffered by the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower Master Teng Shang were actually recovering at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Although this recovery speed is far inferior to Jian Chen's source of life, the effect is also extremely amazing.
The Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower is also immortal!
Its ability comes from the immortal phoenix in the Xuanhuang Small Heaven Realm.
In the Xuanhuang Small Heaven Realm, the immortal phoenix guarding the Kaitian Divine Tree was killed by Mo Tianyun and Master Yu together with the purple and green swords. In the end, the body of the immortal phoenix was taken away by Jian Chen and used as a major resource for the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower to increase its strength.
After the Immortal Devouring Demonic Flower devoured the body of the Phoenix, it also inherited the immortality ability unique to that Phoenix.
Of course, this so-called immortality does not mean immortality in the true sense, but refers to its amazingly fast recovery ability, which is almost equivalent to immortality.
And it is precisely because of the blessing of this immortal ability that the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower can sustain for such a long time in the hands of Lord Ba Lei.
boom! boom! boom!
In the empty temple, the roar of thunder power was heard one after another. Lord Eight Thunders took crazy action, and the mighty power of the fifth level of the Immortal Realm vibrated between the heaven and the earth, blooming with extremely bright brilliance.
He launched a dozen attacks in a very short period of time, as violent as a violent storm, and then finally, with a deafening roar, the cage made of the eight intertwined main wings of the Immortal Devouring Demon Flower was broken inch by inch.
Suddenly, the cage shattered, and the eight masters turned into countless fragments flying everywhere.
